steps: 1. Execute only the first unresolved task, proposal-content: reconcile the governing proposal with current evidence for MC01–MC35 and G1–G18. Required outputs are docs/plans/accounting-proposal/p15-audit-v1.md, data/accounting-master/deliverables/P15/coverage.json, result.md and progress.md. Keep supporting snapshots/check captures under the permitted proposal directory. Stop after this P15 audit and its checks; do not repair historical implementations.

2. Record the skeptical audit before authoring. Reject Core 0's existence as a selection baseline, historical acceptance as whole-product approval, test counts as accounting evidence, and acquired-page counts as semantic coverage. Compare alternatives on identical mission obligations. Treat old checkpoints as dated evidence and empty captures as unusable. The revised plan passes because it produces an evidence-backed proposal assessment, uses no runtime/environment-dependent experiments, preserves unresolved decisions and has a defined stop condition.

3. Establish stable evidence identities. Inspect manuscript sections and existing PDF passages relevant to each obligation, then retain exact file hashes and section/page/line anchors. Snapshot any changing supervisor records needed for acceptance chronology under the permitted proposal directory, preserving origin and capture time. Do not pin live state or next-plan files as durable evidence. Create progress.md after the first inspection and update it after meaningful work, within 600 words.

4. Reconcile all fifteen historical phases. Locate P00 baseline.json and P01 source-work-register.json in their historical run directories; their absence from deliverables/P00 and P01 does not mean unexecuted. For P02–P08/P11/P12 inspect structured results, relevant code/source anchors and retained checker/review records supporting each consequential claim. Classify source preparation as source_evidence and bounded implementations as exploratory_probe, recording mixed contributions in the narrative. Mark P09/P10/P13/P14 unexecuted using retained phase-state and contract evidence. Preserve P08's Australian bond probe and later partial EU preparation, incomplete criterion 3 and accounting-validity limits; reconcile the empty capture against nonempty supervisor reports without rerunning P08.

5. Write the substantive audit and coverage matrix. Give each MC and G exactly one current assessment, remaining_work, design_consequence and located evidence. Separate direct requirements, policy duties and derived engineering choices. Use open/partial/specified/checked_design only for the actual design evidence. Read original acceptance wording rather than copying historical status labels. Connect manuscript statements to prototype evidence where useful, identify contradictions or unsupported claims, and distinguish specified behaviour, implemented probes, tested invariants, accounting validity, empirical validity and human acceptance.

6. Compare at least three proposed initial profiles: the existing bounded financing/Core 0 profile; an evidence-and-history profile centred on a real filing package and unresolved interpretations; and a broader ordinary-corporate lifecycle profile spanning operating accounts and statements. Compare mission coverage, prerequisite authority, semantic expressiveness, integration burden, discriminating acceptance examples and unresolved costs on common criteria. Record why each is viable or limited; do not invent effort estimates or infer preference from sunk implementation. Populate candidate_initial_profile, profile_alternative and selection_question with substantive provisional analysis.

7. Record material decisions with question, proposed_answer, alternative, consequence, next_step and blocks_proposal. Include initial scope, language versus typed-code authoring, supported reconstruction/uncertainty, standards and sector boundaries, source availability, integration evidence and acceptance meaning where unresolved. Allocate remaining work to P16–P19 or later empirical/product work without weakening the original obligation. Under MC35, retain feasible internal research on the internal queue; identify professional judgment only with the preparation still required.

8. Assemble coverage.json with schema_version accdsl.proposal.p15.v1, product_implemented false, human_acceptance pending, substantive limitations, source_evidence, 53 coverage rows, 15 prior_work rows, decisions, profile alternatives and audit_note references. Write result.md with the actual audit outcome, criterion-by-criterion evidence, changed-file inventory, unresolved decisions and next action. Run the registered checker early enough to repair structural defects and preserve the final response interval. Finish only when all required audit content and checks are complete; otherwise retain progress and report the exact unfinished rows or evidence reconciliations as partial work.
summary: Plan one bounded P15 proposal audit: reconcile all requirements, gaps and historical phases, compare initial profiles fairly, and preserve unresolved decisions. Verified blockers to completion are missing deliverables and inconsistent historical evidence, including an empty P08 checker capture.
